name: e6
description: E6 message-size sweep: sign and verify time of all 22 signature schemes over messages of 64 B, 1 KiB, 10 KiB, 100 KiB and 1 MiB (random bytes; the library's reuse objects, as in E1; one process per scheme, operation and size), 5 repetitions. Approved budgets: fast = 1,000 warm-up + 10,000 samples; slow = at least 60 s and 30 samples; classification and batch sizes from trial-e6. Every signature is verified and every verification checked.
